_README: Copy to appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) and fill in the blanks. Never put a password in this example file.
The API refuses to start without the MPGS_* keys, BOOKING_SITE_URL and API_PUBLIC_URL.

Development: API_PUBLIC_URL is this local API's own URL (the gateway sends the guest's browser back to {API_PUBLIC_URL}/api/public/booking/verify); BOOKING_SITE_URL is the local website (Astro, npm run dev).
MPGS_API_PASSWORD: the TESTMOKANDCO profile's API password. MPGS_TEST_3DS_BYPASS works only for a TEST merchant profile and is never set in production.

Production sets the same keys in /etc/mokaco/api.env. The site is SAME-ORIGIN there (its nginx vhost proxies /api to this API; there is no api. host), so API_PUBLIC_URL = BOOKING_SITE_URL = https://mokanco.com.lb.
